# AI Search Readiness Tools

> Free tools to check and generate LLMs.txt files. Validate your website's AI crawler access, sitemap, and technical readiness for AI-powered search.

## Tools

- [LLMs.txt Checker](https://ai-search-readiness.s01071233604.workers.dev/tools/llms-txt-checker): Check if your site has a valid LLMs.txt file. Get a technical readiness report.
- [LLMs.txt Generator](https://ai-search-readiness.s01071233604.workers.dev/tools/llms-txt-generator): Generate an LLMs.txt file from your sitemap or manual input.
- [AEO Checker](https://ai-search-readiness.s01071233604.workers.dev/tools/aeo-checker): Audit technical answer engine optimization readiness, structured data, trust signals, and AI crawler access.
- [Query Fan-Out Tool](https://ai-search-readiness.s01071233604.workers.dev/tools/query-fan-out-tool): Simulate related sub-queries, intent clusters, headings, FAQs, and content gaps.

## Guides

- [What Is an LLMs.txt File?](https://ai-search-readiness.s01071233604.workers.dev/guides/llms-txt-file): Format, examples, and how to create one.
- [Does LLMs.txt Help SEO?](https://ai-search-readiness.s01071233604.workers.dev/guides/llms-txt-seo): What it can and cannot do for your search visibility.
- [What Is LLMs-full.txt?](https://ai-search-readiness.s01071233604.workers.dev/guides/llms-full-txt): When to use it and how it differs from LLMs.txt.
- [AEO Audit Guide](https://ai-search-readiness.s01071233604.workers.dev/guides/aeo-audit): Technical answer engine optimization checklist for crawlability, schema, content, entities, and trust.
- [Query Fan-Out Guide](https://ai-search-readiness.s01071233604.workers.dev/guides/query-fan-out): How to plan answer-ready content with simulated sub-queries, intents, FAQs, and content gaps.

## Blog

- [AI Crawlers and Search Readiness](https://ai-search-readiness.s01071233604.workers.dev/blog/ai-crawlers-search-readiness): How GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, OAI-SearchBot, and other AI crawlers interact with robots.txt and AI-readable files.
- [AI Search vs SEO](https://ai-search-readiness.s01071233604.workers.dev/blog/ai-search-vs-seo): How AI search visibility differs from traditional search optimization.
- [AEO vs SEO](https://ai-search-readiness.s01071233604.workers.dev/blog/aeo-vs-seo): The practical difference between answer engine optimization and SEO.
- [How to Get Cited by ChatGPT](https://ai-search-readiness.s01071233604.workers.dev/blog/how-to-get-cited-by-chatgpt): Content, schema, entity, and trust signals that can improve citation readiness.

## Glossary

- [AI Search Readiness Glossary](https://ai-search-readiness.s01071233604.workers.dev/glossary): Definitions for LLMs.txt, AEO, GEO, AI crawlers, structured data, answer-ready content, trust signals, and related AI search terms.
